_about: Reinforcement rule rows for the LOD Upgrade pack 'Rebar from schedule' (bim-ootb prompts/MODELLER_LOD_UPGRADE_PILL.md section 3; ported from bim-compiler scripts/lod/rebar_defaults.json). Every row: value, unit, source. source = 'stated: <where the drawing says it>' | 'default: ours (...)' | 'default: <standard and table>' | 'unset: ...' (no value read yet). A stated schedule value read from the model always wins over a row here, and a row filled in with a 'stated:' source wins over a default. Change a row, re-run; no code change. No project values are kept in this file.

footing_cover_mm.source: default: ours (concrete cast against earth, practice; no clause read)

laps_modelled.source: default: ours (no laps; every bar is checked against the stock length)

stock_length_mm.source: default: ours (12 m stock bar length used only for the no-lap check)

column_zone_A_stated_in.source: unset: no stated end-zone length read yet (enter the length the drawing writes next to (A), with a 'stated:' source, and it wins)

column_zone_A_rule.source: default: ours (reading of the two labels on a typical column long section: a stated length and 'L/6'; L = clear height, footing top to beam soffit)

bar_sides.source: default: ours (facets of a bar prism)

inside_tol_mm.source: default: ours (INSIDE witness tolerance, from the spec: cover - 1 mm)

footing_bottom_layer.source: default: ours (layer order is not on the schedule; long-side bars lowest)

column_bar_face_normal_axis.source: default: ours (which two opposite faces carry the 3 + 3 main bars is not drawn)
